subject: Demo recap + POC plan — FinTechCorp evaluation
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechcorp.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Demo recap + POC plan — Redwood trial for FinTechCorp

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for taking time today — appreciate the deep questions from the platform and DS teams. Quick recap from our side and a proposed POC plan so we can align on scope and next steps.

Demo recap (high level):
- We showed the r1 LLM routing flow, prefix caching for high-frequency prompts, and the Dedicated pool model variants.
- Key wins for you: predictable 99th pct latency, configurable routing by cost/latency, and out-of-the-box observability for token-level cost breakdowns.

What we heard as your priorities:
1) Evaluate end-to-end inference latency on your 8k sequence risk model workloads.
2) Verify cost per 1M tokens and the impact of prefix caching on cold vs warm starts.
3) Validate integration with your GCS data store and SSO/KMS constraints.

Proposed POC plan (outline):
- Success criteria (to be agreed):
  * 99th pct latency <= 220ms for 95% of production-like traffic
  * Cost per request within 15% of our forecast for your baseline workload
  * Seamless connectivity to GCS and SSO-based auth for the private connector
- Scope: 2-week technical trial (staging traffic), Redwood hosted with dedicated connector to your GCS bucket, one model variant (r1-large) + quantized variant for cost comparison.
- Timeline:
  * Week 0 (this week): finalize scope and add relevant owners + NDA/DSA checks
  * Week 1: connector + sample dataset ingest, baseline latency runs
  * Week 2: load tests, caching experiments, cost analysis, and final review
- Owners:
  * Redwood AE: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.ai) — overall POC owner
  * Redwood CS/Integration: Rachel Kim (rachel.kim@redwood.ai) — connector and onboarding
  * FinTechCorp: Alex Johnson (platform lead) & Priya Singh (ML infra lead) — data access and test traffic
- Deliverables: POC runbook, connector checklist, sample workload scripts, final performance + cost report.

Attached: FinTechCorp-POC-Scope.pdf (detailed step-by-step) and an integration checklist.

Next steps / asks from you:
1) Confirm the success criteria above (especially the latency target) or propose alternatives.
2) Confirm owners and a good window for Week 1 (we suggest starting Monday 12/28).
3) Provide a temporary service account for GCS access (scope: read-only to the test bucket) and a contact for SSO/KMS questions.

If the timeline looks tight around holidays, we can start light on Week 1 (connector only) and run the bulk in early January; happy to be flexible.

Thanks — I can hop on a quick 20-min call tomorrow if that helps finalize the scope.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0192

Attachments: FinTechCorp-POC-Scope.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
